title: Toki Pona to Pictiq pilot crosswalk

semantic_rule.toki_pona: Toki Pona primarily compresses vocabulary by allowing broad lexical concepts.
semantic_rule.pictiq: Pictiq often compresses communication by relying on context and communicative intent.
semantic_rule.equivalence_warning: A mapping records useful overlap, not lexical equivalence. For example, telo is not equal to need_water even when need_water is the best available Pictiq tile.

mapping_classes.direct: One existing Pictiq tile covers the central semantic field with only minor caveats.
mapping_classes.partial: The Pictiq tile overlaps meaningfully but is narrower, broader, or intent-specific.
mapping_classes.composed: More than one existing Pictiq tile is needed.
mapping_classes.contextual: Situation, neighboring tiles, or visual context supplies essential meaning.
mapping_classes.none: No defensible mapping exists in the current Pictiq lexicon.

toki_pona_repository.provenance_note: This file is the repository's current 120-word membership list. It carries no item-level source metadata; the English meanings below are concise pilot research glosses, not copied dictionary definitions or claims of canonical equivalence.

sitelen_pona.mechanism: Latin word input shaped as one OpenType ligature by sitelen seli kiwen asuki
sitelen_pona.author: KreativeKorp / jan Lepeka

sitelen_emoji.profile_behavior: Static frozen word-to-Unicode mapping; generated copies exist for consumers, but this profile is the source of truth.
sitelen_emoji.rendering: Unicode values are rendered in the grid with Twemoji 17.0.0 PNG assets.

mappings.notes: need_water is water/drink with practical intent; telo also covers liquids and related actions.
need_food expresses food or hunger; moku also acts as eat, drink, and consume.
money_coins means cash/pay cash and is narrower than money, wealth, or property.

mappings.meaning: indoor constructed space; building; home; room
mappings.notes: Pictiq has specific places such as hotel and shop, but no generic building or home.
service_tools covers tools and repair, not the wider class of devices and machines.
The current lexicon has no generic person tile.
qty_5 covers only the numerical use; it says nothing about hand or arm.
No current Pictiq tile encodes looking, seeing, or an eye.

mappings.meaning: move; go; toward; for; from the perspective of
mappings.notes: move_feet covers walking or going on foot, not direction, benefit, or viewpoint.
service_tools overlaps with repair work but does not represent general doing or making.
The current protocol has no generic possession or containment relation.
need_water can realize wile e telo in context; it cannot represent wile by itself.
logic_yes can signal approval or OK; it does not lexicalize goodness or simplicity.
logic_no can reject something in context; it does not mean bad, harmful, or complex.
qty_plus means more, not generic size, importance, length, or adulthood.
qty_minus means less, not generic smallness, youth, or a small quantity.
punct_question marks a question but does not encode the unknown argument carried by seme.
logic_no directly covers no/not; Toki Pona also permits nothing and zero readings.
logic_yes can answer a can-I question affirmatively; it does not encode ability or possibility.
love_heart covers affection or romance, only a narrow subset of feeling and sensation.

gap_assessment.reason: People are independently frequent participants in short messages and pointing interactions.
A generic destination or shelter is useful beyond the crosswalk and is not replaced by hotel or shop.
Useful for attention and observation, but the intended communicative act needs user testing.
It is an abstract relation whose visual reading would depend heavily on operands and grammar.
Physical size can be useful, but importance and adulthood should not be folded into the same tile.
Physical smallness may be useful, but youth and few require different context and qty_minus already covers less.

linking_plan.pictiq_readme:
### Related projects

Toki Pona Translator explores a deliberately minimal constructed language and its visual writing systems.

Pictiq approaches a related problem from a different direction: a constrained visual protocol for short messages.

https://github.com/markoblogo/toki-pona-translator
linking_plan.toki_pona_readme:
### Related experiments

Pictiq is a minimal visual protocol for short messages across language barriers.

The Pictiq ↔ Toki Pona crosswalk explores how Toki Pona concepts correspond to a constrained intent-oriented visual system.

https://github.com/markoblogo/pictiq
